name: HHAR → UCI-HAR
description: Train on HHAR (6 activities, multiple phone models, 50Hz resampled, 9 subjects) and evaluate on UCI-HAR (6 activities, waist smartphone, 50Hz, 30 subjects). 5 shared classes are evaluated: Walking, Stairs Up/Walking Upstairs, Stairs Down/Walking Downstairs, Sitting, Standing. HHAR Biking and UCI-HAR Laying are excluded. This pair tests generalization from heterogeneous devices to a single homogeneous device.

protocol.type: Train on source, test on target
protocol.source_train: HHAR subjects 1–8 (each LOSO fold as source)
protocol.note: Source trained on each LOSO fold (8 subjects), evaluated on UCI-HAR fixed test set. Report mean ± std across 9 LOSO folds.
